name: Demo Heroku - Dynamic Controls
description: Remove and re-add a dynamic checkbox while demonstrating step dependencies.

testSteps.name: Open dynamic controls page
testSteps.description: Navigate to the public dynamic controls demo page.

testSteps.name: Remove checkbox
testSteps.description: Click Remove and wait for the checkbox to disappear.

testSteps.name: Verify checkbox removed
testSteps.description: Verify the checkbox is gone and the page reports completion.

testSteps.name: Add checkbox back
testSteps.description: Click Add and wait for the checkbox to return.

testSteps.name: Verify checkbox returned
testSteps.description: Verify the checkbox is visible again.
